jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Fletcher School District, a town school district in the Franklin West Supervisory Union (member town: Fletcher).

sources.note: Fletcher School Board page (Franklin West SU, official): five directors -- Jess Graff (Chair), David Clark, Stephanie Sheldon-Purinton (Clerk), Allison Stafford, Morgan Lawton. The board is five directors at-large (16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b); FWSU's official 2017 Alternative Structure Application to the State Board of Education states each Franklin West district 'maintains a 5-person board of school directors'.) No term expirations are published in any fetched official source (the missing document is the Fletcher FY27 Combined Warning / 2026 annual meeting record), so no ends are asserted. The one documented appointment (a 2024 vacancy) returned its seat to election in March 2025; there is no evidence any current member is an appointee, and all five are recorded elected on the district's own roster.
